raw_definitions: Definisi : n 1. body of wrecked or abandoned ship, bangkai kapal; 2. big, unwieldy vessel, kapal bagur; 3. big, clumsy person or animal, (/orang yg, binatang yg/) bagur: a ~ of a man, seorang lelaki yg bagur; 4. heavy, unwieldy object or mass, ( approp n ) + yg tersergam: the great ~ of the mountain range, banjaran gunung yg tersergam. (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)
